Upper Text: ＜Use Req. ([DM] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [DM] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When face-down cards are placed in any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Delay＞.
・Any of those Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower [DM] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
